work_classes.name: AuthN
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes how a caller's identity is proven: login, sessions, MFA, SSO, OIDC or SAML flows.

work_classes.name: AuthZ
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes what a caller may do: permission checks, role or attribute rules, policy evaluation, tenant isolation.

work_classes.name: Identity
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes the record of who a principal is: user and service accounts, identity providers and federation, how identities are created, linked or removed.

work_classes.name: Access grants and escalation
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes who holds access: IAM policies, roles, trust policies, role assumption, admin elevation, sharing and ACL changes.

work_classes.name: Cryptography
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes signing, verifying, hashing for security, key derivation, secure randomness, certificate validation, TLS settings.

work_classes.name: Encryption
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes encrypting or decrypting data at rest or in transit: key choice, key service use, envelope encryption.

work_classes.name: Secrets
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes creating, storing, rotating, reading or sending a secret; the secret store itself.

work_classes.name: Tokens
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes issuing, signing, validating, refreshing or revoking a token.

work_classes.name: API keys
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes issuing, storing, validating, scoping or rotating an API key.

work_classes.name: Credentials
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes storing, comparing or resetting credentials; credential files.

work_classes.name: Untrusted input
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes the first parse or check of input from outside the system.

work_classes.name: Network exposure
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes what is reachable and from where: firewall rules, security groups, public endpoints, CORS.

work_classes.name: Audit trail
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes the security log itself and what keeps it tamper-evident.

work_classes.name: Policy as code
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes the rules a security scanner or guard enforces, the scanner's configuration, and any exception to or skip of a rule.

work_classes.name: Plumbing
work_classes.definition: The work builds or changes none of the things another class names, including work that only uses one of them.

work_classes.name: Mechanical
work_classes.definition: The work needs no judgement: a rename, a move, a copy or a format pass.
